title: Numbers: A teacher shares bags of candy with a class of 23.
src:
# A teacher shares bags of candy with a class of 23.
# Each time the candy is split evenly between the children present;
# the remainder goes into the teacher's jar.

class_size = 23
jar = 0
every_day = 0

print("Monday: bag of 157")
bag = 157
kids = class_size
every_day += bag // kids
jar += bag % kids
print(bag // kids)
print(jar)

print("Tuesday: 3 absent")
# the jar is emptied into the new bag
bag = 96 + jar
jar = 0
kids = class_size - 3
every_day += bag // kids
jar += bag % kids
print(bag // kids)
print(jar)

print("Wednesday: bag of 64")
bag = 64
kids = class_size
every_day += bag // kids
jar += bag % kids
print(bag // kids)
print(jar)

print("Thursday: 4 helpers")
# the jar is split between the 4 helpers who cleaned up
helpers = 4
print(jar // helpers)
jar %= helpers
print(jar)

print("--- week ---")
# candy for a child who came every day
print(every_day)
print(jar)

title: Numbers: A week of trading one stock. The price moves every day,…
src:
# A week of trading one stock. The price moves every day, sometimes
# down. We buy and sell whole shares only, starting with 600 coins.

price = 48
cash = 600
shares = 0
spent = 0

print("Monday: buy 10")
shares += 10
spent += 10 * price
cash -= 10 * price
print(cash)

print("Tuesday")
change = -6
price += change
print(price)
print(shares * price)

print("Wednesday: buy the dip")
change = -9
price += change
spent += 3 * price
cash -= 3 * price
shares += 3
print(price)
print(cash)
print(shares * price)

print("Thursday")
change = 17
price += change
print(price)
print(shares * price)

print("Friday: sell everything")
change = -2
price += change
cash += shares * price
print(price)
print(cash)

print("--- week ---")
# average price paid per share
print(spent // shares)
shares = 0
gain = cash - 600
print(gain)
# 1 percent of 600 is 6
print(gain // 6)
print(gain % 6)

title: Numbers: Rabbits in a meadow, followed one generation at a time.
src:
# Rabbits in a meadow, followed one generation at a time.
# Every 3 rabbits produce 1 baby (rounded down).
# The foxes catch (rabbits % 7) plus one rabbit per fox,
# and every 15 rabbits still alive attract one more fox.

rabbits = 20
foxes = 2

print("Generation 1")
births = rabbits // 3
deaths = rabbits % 7 + foxes
rabbits += births - deaths
foxes += rabbits // 15
print(rabbits)
print(foxes)

print("Generation 2")
births = rabbits // 3
deaths = rabbits % 7 + foxes
rabbits += births - deaths
foxes += rabbits // 15
print(rabbits)
print(foxes)

print("Generation 3")
births = rabbits // 3
deaths = rabbits % 7 + foxes
rabbits += births - deaths
foxes += rabbits // 15
print(rabbits)
print(foxes)

print("Generation 4: a good spring, twice the babies")
births = rabbits // 3 * 2
deaths = rabbits % 7 + foxes
rabbits += births - deaths
foxes += rabbits // 15
print(rabbits)
print(foxes)

# a hard winter: a quarter of the foxes leave the meadow
print("Generation 5: hard winter")
foxes -= foxes // 4
births = rabbits // 3
deaths = rabbits % 7 + foxes
rabbits += births - deaths
print(rabbits)
print(foxes)

print("--- summary ---")
print(rabbits - 20)
print(foxes - 2)

title: Numbers: The final boss hides behind a magic shield.
src:
# The final boss hides behind a magic shield.
# While the shield holds, it soaks up half of every hit (rounded down).
# The knight's sword gets 5 points sharper after every round.

boss_hp = 300
shield = 40
sword = 22
knight_hp = 90
boss_power = 13

print("Round 1")
absorbed = sword // 2
shield -= absorbed
boss_hp -= sword - absorbed
knight_hp -= boss_power
sword += 5
print(boss_hp)
print(shield)

print("Round 2")
absorbed = sword // 2
shield -= absorbed
boss_hp -= sword - absorbed
knight_hp -= boss_power
sword += 5
print(boss_hp)
print(shield)

print("Round 3")
absorbed = sword // 2
shield -= absorbed
boss_hp -= sword - absorbed
knight_hp -= boss_power
sword += 5
print(boss_hp)
print(shield)

print("The shield shatters!")
# the boss is furious and hits harder
boss_power += 5

print("Round 4")
boss_hp -= sword * 2
knight_hp -= boss_power
print(boss_hp)
print(knight_hp)

print("Round 5: elixir")
# the elixir doubles the knight's health before the hit
knight_hp *= 2
boss_hp -= sword * 3
knight_hp -= boss_power
print(boss_hp)
print(knight_hp)

print("Round 6")
boss_hp -= sword * 2 + 4
print(boss_hp)

print("--- summary ---")
print(knight_hp)
print(sword)
# overkill: how far below zero the boss went
print(-boss_hp)

src:

    dimes += 1

title: Loops: Every third house on the block: odd numbers on the left…
Loops: Single elimination bracket, odd team out gets a bye
src:
# single elimination bracket, odd team out gets a bye
teams = 50
rounds = 0
while teams > 1:
    if teams % 2 == 1:
        teams += 1
    teams //= 2
    rounds += 1
    print(teams)
print(rounds)

title: Strings: Roman numerals
src:
sym = "IVXLCDM"
n = 649
m = n
out = ""
p = 0
while m > 0:
    d = m % 10
    one = sym[p]
    if d == 9:
        part = one + sym[p + 2]
    elif d >= 5:
        part = sym[p + 1] + one * (d - 5)
    elif d == 4:
        part = one + sym[p + 1]
    else:
        part = one * d
    out = part + out
    m //= 10
    p += 2
print(n, out)

title: Strings: Tic-tac-toe board
src:
# Tic-tac-toe from nine one-character cells after a fixed game.
# X takes the anti-diagonal on the seventh move.
a = b = c = d = e = f = g = h = i = "."
e = "X"
a = "O"
c = "X"
b = "O"
d = "X"
f = "O"
g = "X"
print(a, b, c, sep="|")
print("-+-+-")
print(d, e, f, sep="|")
print("-+-+-")
print(g, h, i, sep="|")
winner = "nobody"
if a != "." and a == b and b == c:
    winner = a
if d != "." and d == e and e == f:
    winner = d
if g != "." and g == h and h == i:
    winner = g
if a != "." and a == e and e == i:
    winner = a
if c != "." and c == e and e == g:
    winner = c
print("winner:", winner)

title: Strings: Run-length encoding
src:
s = "aaabbcaaaa"
out = ""
run = 1
for i in range(1, len(s)):
    if s[i] == s[i - 1]:
        run += 1
    else:
        out = out + s[i - 1] + str(run)
        run = 1
out = out + s[-1] + str(run)
print(out, len(out))

title: Strings: Palindromes
Strings: Battery meter
src:
level = 73
while level > 0:
    filled = level // 10
    gauge = "[" + "|" * filled + "." * (10 - filled) + "]"
    print("battery", gauge, str(level) + "%")
    if level < 30:
        print("plug in soon")
    level -= 25
print("screen off")
